# MLspike `spikes/` — no licence file

`spk_autosigma.m` is from **MLspike** (Deneux et al. 2016, *Nature Communications* 7:12190;
https://github.com/MLspike/spikes). The copy this pipeline ran carried no licence file, so it
is included here unmodified, as distributed, with this provenance note. It is **not** covered
by this repository's MIT licence. custard uses it through `TDnoise2.m` to estimate trace noise.
